newsitem.title: USA: United Wisconsin Q1 seen as industry upturn.
newsitem.headline: United Wisconsin Q1 seen as industry upturn.

text.p: United Wisconsin Services Inc said Tuesday it believes the company's strong first-quarter earnings reflect an upturn in the business cycle for managed care.
The company earned $0.21 per share, up from $0.02. Revenues rose to $414.3 million from $281.4 million.

"We are encouraged by the substantial improvement in first-quarter results," said chairman Thomas Hefty. He said the company's Milwaukee HMO achieved significant growth; turnaround of its American Medical Security operation is on plan; and the company's specialty business unit continued to produce strong returns.
